description: This PHP source file defines the TransactionException class within the OrangeHRM project's ORM exception namespace. It extends the base Exception class and provides a custom constructor to initialize exception instances related to transaction failures.

classes.name: TransactionException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling transaction-related errors within the ORM component of OrangeHRM. It extends the base PHP Exception class and offers a constructor to specify error message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TransactionException instance, defaulting the message to 'Transaction Failed' and accepting a previous Throwable for exception chaining.
